meta.name: Kimi Chiang Portfolio — Design Tokens
meta.description: Design system tokens extracted from the live site (Studio.design build) via computed-style inspection.

primary.role: primary text / UI foreground, logo, dividers

accent.role: emphasis only via value contrast — category tag chips and heading underline; no distinct hue accent exists in the chrome

neutral.usage: #FFFFFF = page/card background, #666666 = body/description copy, #333333 = link & tertiary text, #000000 = headings, primary text, dividers, tag-chip fill

color.contrast_strategy: Pure black-on-white, high contrast, no midtone surface layers. All color/vibrancy in the page comes from case-study thumbnail images (e.g. Binance yellow, purple gradient), never from UI chrome.
color._notes: semantic colors are inferred conventions, not observed — this static portfolio has no form/alert states. Everything else above was read directly from computed styles.

typography.font_style_notes: Poppins (light 300–400 weight) carries the narrative voice — hero heading, intro paragraph, CTA. Card/project titles break from this using Lato at weight 900 (heavy/black) for punch. heading_2/heading_3/body_small are interpolated — not directly observed on this single-page site, only display (50px/300/-2px), heading_1 (28px Lato 900), body (16px/#666), and caption (12px, white-on-black chip) were measured.

spacing.section_rhythm: Large, deliberate gaps (~100–130px) separate the hero, project list, and contact block — each reads as its own breathing section rather than a continuous flow.

layout.grid_system: single-column vertical stack; no visible multi-column grid
layout.max_content_width: 1265px (near full-bleed at a 1280px viewport — roughly 7–8px side inset, not a classic centered container)
layout.columns: 1 (project cards internally split ~50/50 into image half + text half, alternating)
layout.gutter: n/a — no column grid; card image container measured 575px within a 933px card
layout.breakpoints: Only desktop (~1280–1440px) appears deliberately tuned. At 375px mobile width, fixed-width text blocks do not reflow and wrap mid-word — a builder limitation rather than an intentional mobile design.
layout.alignment_tendency: left-aligned text with a fixed left indent (e.g. 15px on the hero heading); asymmetric image/text pairing per card

shape.border_usage: none — no borders on cards, images, or containers
shape.divider_style: solid black block, 50px × 5px, used as an accent rule under the hero heading rather than a hairline

elevation.shadow_style: none — fully flat, zero box-shadow anywhere measured
elevation.depth_cues: no shadow-based depth; separation comes from scroll-pinned card stacking (cards overlap and reveal one at a time) and from the saturation of case-study images against the stark white ground

iconography.style: emoji + text glyph, not a drawn icon set
iconography.preferred_set: emoji (👋🏻), typographic separators (✦, •), hamburger glyph for the nav toggle — no SVG icon library detected

motion.easing: not measurable from static inspection (rendering environment couldn't capture the live scroll animation)
motion.entrance_pattern: scroll-triggered reveal — an 'appear' class is toggled per section on scroll (IntersectionObserver-style), with project cards pinned/stacked so each covers the previous as you scroll
motion.philosophy: minimal functional — motion exists only to sequence content reveal, no bounce/elastic/playful easing observed

components.button_style: no filled buttons — CTAs are bold, underlined text links (e.g. 'Contact', 'KIMI') in pure black
components.input_style: none observed — no form fields on this page
components.card_style: borderless, shadowless, flat; split into an image half and a text half; revealed one-at-a-time via scroll-pinned stacking rather than a simple vertical list
components.navigation_pattern: fixed top bar: small-caps tracked-out wordmark logo (top-left) + single hamburger icon (top-right); no inline nav links visible by default
components.modal_style: not tested (hamburger menu overlay not opened during this analysis)
components.list_style: vertical stack of project cards, each tagged with a small black pill chip (e.g. 'UI/UX') in the corner
components.component_notes: Tag chip: black pill, 20px radius, 10px padding, 12px white text. Title/body pairing deliberately contrasts a heavy display face (Lato 900) against light narrative Poppins — a weight-contrast strategy rather than a color- or size-contrast one.
